outcome: A user who has forgotten their password can set a new one from a single-use emailed link.

acceptance_criteria.text: A valid, unexpired reset token sets the user's new password.

expected_verification.assertion: resetPassword with a fresh token changes the stored password hash

acceptance_criteria.text: A reset token cannot be used to set a password a second time.

expected_verification.assertion: a second resetPassword call with the same token is refused

acceptance_criteria.text: An expired or unknown token is refused with a reason.

expected_verification.assertion: expired and unknown tokens return ok:false with a reason

data_impact: No schema change. Existing reset tokens keep their current lifetime.
rollout: Ships with the release; no flag.
